Subject: Quarter Launch — Owners Command Center: alignment, contingency routing, sign-off

Team —

Per our roadmap cadence, we need a short Owners Command Center this week to finalize OKR owners, confirm the runbook, and lock the sign-off path for Q2 launch. The goal is to make final owner commitments and identify any contingency routing (fallbacks, tolerant SLAs, and who picks up hot-seat pages).

Proposed agenda (30m):
- Quick rollcall: owners confirm charters (5m)
- Runbook highlights and contingency routing (10m)
- Open blockers: procurement/infra/compliance flags (10m)
- Final sign-off and next steps (5m)

Please review the attached runbook and the Owners_Rollcall_Tracker before the meeting. Action items I want closed in the thread:
1) Confirm owner for 'Model Serving QoS' (owner and backup)
2) Confirm rollout gate metrics (latency p95, cost/unit threshold)
3) Flag any procurement dependencies (contract or marketplace listings)

Proposed times: Mon 3/8 09:00-09:30 PT or Mon 3/8 15:00-15:30 PT. If neither works, reply with your preference.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q2_Launch_Runbook_v1.pdf, Owners_Rollcall_Tracker.xlsx

Irene — thanks for pulling this together. I can do the 15:00 slot on 3/8. Quick notes after skimming the runbook:
- For 'Model Serving QoS' I propose Karthik Iyer as primary, backed by Marcus Lin on infra; Marcus is OOO next week but can be on-call for the fallback if needed.
- The cost/unit threshold in section 3.2 looks aggressive for live traffic patterns; recommend we add a 14-day observation window post-rollout to verify numbers before enforcing the strict gate.
- Procurement: Linda Park at Avery is still finalizing marketplace paperwork — CC'ing her in follow-ups will help.

If you want, I can draft a one-page fallback decision tree to append to the runbook before the meeting.
